assign.outcome:
**One quick-fix worktree is always warm, and nothing merges without a smoke test.** Call `take_worktree`, write, then `node Server/merge.mjs <path> <pages>`, then `return_worktree`.

![Live card with the pool](/framework/ai/2026-09-25/quickfix-worktrees/live-1920.png)

- [x] no full UI test needed to merge: merge.mjs runs only the smoke test
- [x] fix an error, then merge: the first landing was refused by the smoke test, fixed, then merged ([refused-msys.txt](/framework/ai/2026-09-25/quickfix-worktrees/smoke/proof/refused-msys.txt))
- [x] ready-to-go worktrees: qf-1 ready after the restart, on the Live card (shot above)
- [x] built immediately: take_worktree answered at once live; 57 ms on the private Servex ([private-servex-main.txt](/framework/ai/2026-09-25/quickfix-worktrees/landing/private-servex-main.txt))
- [x] merged within seconds, one at a time: merge.mjs takes a lock ([landing/proof.txt](/framework/ai/2026-09-25/quickfix-worktrees/landing/proof.txt), 41 checks passing)
- [x] keep michael/dev error free: the live.js change was smoke-tested on the live site under a reload hold before any tab reloaded
- [x] no manager agent: Servex prepares the next one; qf-2 appeared when qf-1 was taken
- [x] return and cleanup (at most 3, idle over 6 h): return_worktree live, plus the [pool proof](/framework/ai/2026-09-25/quickfix-worktrees/pool/proof.txt), 14 of 14 checks
